proved_scoped: Every CNF clause of width at most three is routed exactly into 2CNF, Horn3, or dual-Horn3 under the frozen deterministic priority grammar.
The conjunction of all committed typed carriers plus the exact residual is clause-multiset identical to the source CNF.
After all three frozen extraction morphs, the raw residual is empty for every width<=3 source CNF.
Rejected partial-morph proposals do not mutate the committed checkpoint state.
An UNSAT exact carrier safely lifts global UNSAT.
Individually SAT carriers with shared variables do not authorize global SAT.

interaction_killer.formula: all eight signed 3-clauses on variables x1,x2,x3
interaction_killer.interpretation: Polynomial exact representation of every clause does not imply polynomial decision of shared-variable carrier interaction.
